missing_notes.5: No samples of either router on a full-ring multicast (Galaxy or P150, two ERISCs). The nearest existing new-router samples (ring 1-hop write, job 358) are a different traffic pattern and are not used.

router_rule: Per ERISC: the router whose ERISC sets the test's rate where an A/B has identified that router (ab_targets in a point or entry, with its source); otherwise the busiest (largest share of samples in that ERISC's work category: E0 Ethernet send, E1 NoC commands). The one-side delay A/Bs (slack.json, V4_BOUNDS §1, V4_NS_FLOOR §1) spin every router's E0 or every router's E1 at once: they name the bound side, not a router, so today every pick is 'busiest' (user, 2026-11-02).
